⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (4/5)
Visited Ginger and overall had a good experience. The ambience is neat, calm, and suitable for both family dinners and casual outings. The food quality was good—flavors were well balanced and dishes were served fresh. Pan-Asian options stood out the most.
Service was polite, though a bit slow when the restaurant got busy. Portions are decent, but prices feel slightly on the higher side for the quantity served.
Cleanliness and presentation were well maintained, which adds to the overall comfort. A good option in the area if you’re in the mood for Asian cuisine, though service speed and pricing could be improved.

I recently stayed here for four days, and the experience was truly wonderful. The service was excellent throughout my stay. I’d especially like to appreciate the room attendant, Puneet Kumar, who was very helpful and responsive, taking care of all our requirements promptly every time. His support made our stay even more comfortable.

Absolutely comfort and memorable stay not only of mine but my entire team which was staying over a week.
Excellent job from the house keeping team, quite a few names I remember - Puneet Kumar, Nannu Pal and others are served me with due respect and perfectly. Food was also  excellent !
Must recommend this hotel !
Keep up it Team Ginger East
